name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
summary: A life insurance scheme offering cover of Rs. 2 lakh for death due to any reason, available to bank account holders in the age group of 18 to 50 years for a nominal annual premium.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.
The applicant must be 50 years of age or younger at the time of enrolment.

entitlement_rules.text: The nominee receives a life cover of Rs. 2 lakh on the death of the insured due to any reason.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the bank branch.
Final escalation to the Department of Financial Services.
